card: exp_hss_race6_seals — graded attempt v2 (three-fence + clean-ladder pre-gate + seal preservation)
convention_statement: s_str[i] = planted bit on logical system qubit i (i=0..n-1, 0-indexed). s_bits_msb_last = s_str[::-1] = qiskit register order. BUILDER embeds s_str[i]->logical qubit i; DECODER reports s_hat in s_str (0-indexed logical) order; HD vs s_str. Commitment = sha256((s_str+salt).encode()).
seal_preservation_note: per clean-ladder pre-gate (Ember #651): if the t=0 ladder is not exact, race_n40 seal is RETIRED UNOPENED (never revealed) — a dirty register cannot consume the graded race seal.
